ogicSentenceId":"7537984597440675878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年太嵗至辰為官庫，以土為官，主官序隱","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440692262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審，難侵犯，厚重質直，法令分明。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440692262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太嵗至辰為官庫。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440708646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440725030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之官，各隨其性則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440725030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主義，主綱，木主文，主仁，火主禮，主猛，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440741414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水主智，主順，土主信、主重。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440741414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若各失其性，則主為官不久，禍咎生","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440757798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440757798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木命，人以土為祿官，木為命官，金為身官，盖取尅","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我者為官，餘命準此。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子月","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，戊與乙，壬與己，丁與壬為官，乙與","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873440387743778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，戌與丁為印，其官印足，亦至貴之助也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440987174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴觀大貴命與兩印者頗多，少有遇兩官者，若遇兩官，於禄反。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441003558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有所損丁遇兩壬之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441019942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又須四貴華蓋上遇正官者，主大","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四平","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次之。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並三命提要：","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441052710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真官時遇，早達金紫之封；日遇真官，貴則時加祿命。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441052710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日生遇","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441069094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印，須慿有氣之鄉，若遇衝空亡，此等遇如不遇也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441069094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印遇鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441085478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印如無，鬼旺鬼衰，詳其勝負。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441085478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官刑命喜，莫教命反刑官。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441101862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441118246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受刑，縱貴不戎，即吏官印明無暗有。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441118246","marginNoteIdList":null," ist":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎悟理窮幽，達微通變，以盡其妙。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215998510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其為氣也，將来者進，功成者退。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216014894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：將来者進，迎之以臨官帝狂，功成者退，背之以","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休廢死囚，則禍福吉凶可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生逢休敗，早𡻕孤貧；老遇建旺之鄉，臨年偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216047662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：身須逐運，必假運而資身；勢須及時，亦假時而","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二恬。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216080430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506189876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成勢：生逢旺𡻕，運須處於旺鄉；晚遇衰年，運恰宜於困地。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216080430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琰子","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老幼慎勿坐強，壮實惟宜趍旺。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺雖吉而未必吉，衰滅雖凶而未必凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216113198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逹此者始可論運。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216129582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖人自生至老，必從微以至少壮。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216145966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十𡻕、二十𡻕方當少年之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216162350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，惟可行胞胎飬生、沐浴鬼帶䖏；三十、四十崴當陽強齒壮","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216162350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，乃可行旺䖏；五十六十𡻕當天癸枯竭，只可行哀。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216162350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反此","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216178734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，如老得少年脉，少年得老脉，非所宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216178734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值一生運背，三限驅馳，直饒晚入旺鄉，已非符叶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216195118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人初中之限，合行生旺而不生枉，晚老之年，合行衰絶而","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216211502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506206260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不衰絶，乃謂運背。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216211502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等人三限最為驅馳運蹇也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216227886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216244270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216244270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年雖逢於冠帶，尚有餘灾；初入衰年，尤被尠福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216244270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216260654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：年運或初離沐浴暴敗之地，而順行纔至鬼帶之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216260654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上，未可便以為福，盖尚有衰敗之餘災也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216260654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或自任地而行，初","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216277038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至衰鄉，亦不可便以為禍，盖尤被旺鄉之鄉福也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216277038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以行運","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216293422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有前後五行之說，盖由此耶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216293422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將徹不徹，寕有久否之殃；欲交不交，尚有幾殘之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216309806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運在衰絶䖏，将入吉慶之地者，必於臨離之時，更有重撓；運","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216326190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在吉慶之地，将入衰絕之䖏，必於初入之時，更有重福也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216326190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂男陽女，時觀出入之年；隂女陽男，更看元辰之歲。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216342574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506222644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：男，陽也，或禀五行之隂而生，則謂之隂男；女，隂也，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或禀五行之陽而生，則謂之陽女。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂男陽女也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216375342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禀氣不順，故","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216391726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運歴過去節，不順者，時觀出運入運之年，而有吉凶之變。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216391726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順者雖不以出入之年為應，亦不可與元辰之厄㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216408110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命指掌","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216424494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡陰男陽女至交運時，主有灾滯；陽隂男女","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216424494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小運行年元辰，亦為厄難。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216424494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰犯運，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳蔡","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之饑；","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年二運遇元辰，灾福併至，故譬夫子之厄","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳蔡","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運至本命宫，五行生旺，支干和禄馬貴人、食神相生，有益","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216457262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠁅為吉泰之運，亦不能常為福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216457262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須候太𡻕行年，又看五行生","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216473646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506239028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，支干和合福神之地，方可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216473646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運至吉鄉，却遇逐年太","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216490030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡻕，小運到刑害之鄉，亦主細累浮灾，但不為重言也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216490030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至本命宫，五行死絶支千刑衝六害，一切云殺者，為屯蹇凶","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍之運，遇逐年太𡻕，又見刑衝，小運不和，死絶帶殺者，方可","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其小運與太崴到生𦔽祿馬、貴人一切吉神者，其年却","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216522798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主有小喜遂快事，但𡻕神過宫，復如故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216522798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到臨官地事旺相之地，生人盛旺快樂，發權，進財生","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216555566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，骨肉之慶，一運中亨通也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216555566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到衰病之鄉，一運中多","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216571950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退破財疾敗事。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216571950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到死絕鄉，一運中骨肉死䘮，自身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216588334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216604718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506255412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍鈍悶，百事蹇塞也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216604718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到五行敗鄉，主人落魄懶惰，酒","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216621102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色荒迷。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216621102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運到胎庫成形冠帶之鄉，一運中百事得中，安康","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216637486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平易也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216637486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推命之禍，須先度量基厚薄，然後定灾福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216653870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運氣譬之船也，命","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216670254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬之水也，隨其水之廣狹深淺，發得船之力也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216670254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命有八分","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216686638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神，行三四分惡運，多不覺其凶，福力厚後故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216686638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五六分","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216703022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡運，只浮灾細累而已，至七分惡運，方有重灾。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216703022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五分福命，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216719406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行三四分惡運，為凶甚切；若四五分惡運，則須死，盖基地不","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216719406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牢故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216719406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中五行衰者運宜盛，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216735790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寸珠尺璧云凡衰䖏行，運到枉䖏脫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行盛","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216735790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者運宜衰，衰者復行衰運，是謂不刃。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216735790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不刃，則遁塞沉滯；","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216752174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506271796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行盛而復行盛運，是謂太過，過則擊作成敗也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216752174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運行","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216768558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫，曾歷過本命長生𠁅者，謂之氣盛之運，雖歲運来衝","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216768558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅者，為禍不重，盖運氣強故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216768558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大運未經長生，而歲運刑","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216784942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝尅破，則便為灾，盖氣未備，運弱故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216784942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運者，曾過旺相，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216801326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而逢死絕者，為灾輕。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216801326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖隂陽五行代謝之順道也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216817710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱死於此，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216834094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦須令疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216834094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若方經長生，歷於敗地，其中有刑尅惡殺，與","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216850478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命相符而見者，則五行之氣反戰，故為凶惡而終也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216850478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216866862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216866862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216866862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命有氣象，常取生，取時干神為氣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216883246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲時、己時，則土氣也，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216899630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216899630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金、丙辛水之類取之也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216899630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運至氣象得地䖏吉，不得地䖏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216916014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216916014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛壬癸、乙庚丙辛為金水象，運至申酉丑上，得地𢈏辛","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506288180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已、甲已、乙庚為金土象，運至申酉辰上，得地庚辛、丙丁、乙","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚、戊癸為金火象，運至","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已午","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌上，得地庚辛、甲乙、","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398"," {"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若雜而不入象者，不發，發亦不久。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216997934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如五純象，亦","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217014318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有大過之象。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217014318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍詳當生月令得地，然後看行運得地不得地","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217030702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506304564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而言發跡，不可以遇祿馬貴人為得運，遇空亡羊刃却亡為","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217030702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失運也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217030702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運以月上起源，却不可以年月参較灾福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217047086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖有同年同月","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217063470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同日而時不同者，灾禍逈别故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217063470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但以生時支千、納音休旺","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217079854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及神殺斷之，無不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217079854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以月参初限，日参中限，時参未限","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217096238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，則主源不可衝破。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217096238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行且要源發䖏稳實，終耐患難，富貴即可安享。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217112622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如發源在","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217129006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時年空衝死敗之地，縱取富貴，終不稳實，易成易敗也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217129006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更以","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217145390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逐宫消息，最忌太𡻕小運衝擊。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217145390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如根基有此灾福至本宫，其","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217161774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾福立應在年内三合月并太𡻕、輦路月分之上","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217161774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217161774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217161774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齋。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217161774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506320948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行運至夾貴華盖貴人六合上刃乗生旺氣者，皆主善慶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217178158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍須察當生根基十分則應五分；生時五分則應十分。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217194542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217210926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217210926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217210926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217210926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行運至臨官帝旺上，太𡻕持之，官員生薦章改秩之喜，官","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217227310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印食神亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217227310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217243694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺貴人之地，必入参侍之列。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217243694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖貴為君道，馬","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217260078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主遷動故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217260078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡子丑寅卯辰已四柱，陽多人行，運至午未申","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217276462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌亥上，乗隂氣而𤼵。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217276462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未申酉戌亥多人，行子丑寅卯辰","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217292846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已運發名利，乗陽氣而發也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217292846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者隂陽均恊，然隂人陽發者。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256217309230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"快凡水命四柱有土，至火運，本是財運，却反為鬼者，以灾生","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669764147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，土尅水，是財化為鬼，轉福成禍也。","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669764147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水命四柱有金，至土運，","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669780531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506337332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是鬼運，却反為吉者，以土生金，金生水，是化鬼為𦔳，氣反為","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669780531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福。","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669780531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行俱以此為例。","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669796915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡水命四柱有金有火，固是為福，若行水運，則分擘其福，即","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669846067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為不好之運。","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669846067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他凖此。","logicSentenceId":"7538000255669862451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
